book.name: MULUM PASA
book.title: MULUM PASA Kuate tuku mulum pasa Mosesŋge kuyarna

content: Yakob nuŋe gageu kilmba Isip kilke mbol kina
Israel nu agaŋ ndende ŋakmba kuane deŋpurna sulumba mam nuŋe Isak tuku Mbara atraukam Berseba tumbraŋ kina.
Furir ta mbolŋge nu kiŋatanu suk Kuateŋge Yakob tugum promba wika sana: Yakob, Yakob ŋgina le nu woka sakina: Ye minet te ŋgina.
Taŋakina le Kuate nu ndek sana: Ye Kuate. Ye mam naŋe tuku Mbara. Ne Isip kilke mbol kambim tuku kuru kuru ndaka. Yeŋge ki le ne tuku wa kat naŋe tuku kuasmbi tugekamŋgaig.
Ye ne ndoŋ Isip kaŋgik. Taŋamba ŋgumneŋga ye ne tuku wa kat naŋe tuku kuasmbi kilmba maŋ luka te prowamŋgit. Yosef nu ne ndoŋ minmba ka ne kuma le nuŋge ne tuku am tukulniŋgamŋgat ŋgina.
Yakob nu Berseba tumbraŋ kusrena le nuŋe kiŋo kat nuŋe nu tumba naŋgine kutu kame foŋfoŋ naŋgine pino kame ŋakmba kilmba karis nane kilam tuku Faraoŋge patikina ta mbolŋge patikinaig.
Taŋamba nane makau kilmba agaŋ ndende afu Kananŋge kilnaig ta turmba kilmba Isip kinaig. Yakob nu nuŋe kutu kame
wa kat nuŋe ta ŋakmba kilmba kina.
Yakob tuku kuasmbi 70
Israel nuŋe kuasmbi kilmba Isip kilke mbol kina ta nane tuku nyu naŋgine ta teŋenmba. Kiŋo mulum ta nyunu Ruben.
Ruben tuku kiŋo kame ta Hanok, Palu, Hesron, Karmi.
Simeon tuku kiŋo kame ta Yemuel, Yamin, Ohad, Yakin, Sohar, Saul. Saul nu Kanannu pino ande ndoŋ tinaik.
Levi tuku kiŋo kame ta Gesron, Koat, Merari.
Yuda tuku kiŋo kame ta Er, Onan, Sila, Peres, Sera. (Er le Onan nale Kananŋge kumnaik). Peres tuku kiŋo armba. Ande nyunu Hesron ande Hamul.
Isakar tuku kiŋo kame ta Tola, Pua, Yasub (nyunu ande Yob), Simron.
Sebulun tuku kiŋo kame ta Seret, Elon, Yalel.
Yakob tuku kiŋo kame 6 ta ŋakmba Lea ndoŋ Mesopotamia kilke mbolŋge minmba kile-patikinaik. Nu kulim ande turmba te-pilna ta nyunu Dina. Lea tuku kiŋo kame wa kat nuŋe ta ulendimba 33.
Gat tuku kiŋo kat nuŋe ta teŋenmba. Sefon, Hagi, Suni, Esbon, Eri, Arod, Areli.
Aser tuku kiŋo kame ta Imna, Iswa, Iswi, Beria. Kulim naŋgine nyunu Sera. Beria tuku kiŋo kat nuŋe ta Heber le Malkiel.
Nane 16 ta ŋakmba Yakob tuku ndare. Yakob nu Zilpa ndoŋ Gat le Aser kile-patikinaik. (Zilpa nu piro pino ande Labanŋge kulim nuŋe Lea tuna tuku).
Yakob piyo nuŋe Rahel tuku kiŋo armba ta Yosef le Benyamin.
Yosef nu Isipnu pino Asenat tina sulumba kiŋo armba kile-patikina ta Manase le Efraim. (Asenat nu Potifera tuku kulim nuŋe. Potifera nu Heliopolis tuku pris gabat).
Benyamin tuku kiŋo kat nuŋe ta teŋenmba. Bela, Beker, Asbel, Gera, Naman, Ehi, Ros, Mupim, Hupim, Art.
Nane 14 ta ŋakmba Yakob le Rahel tuku ndare.
Dan tuku kiŋo ta nyunu Husim.
Naftali tuku kiŋo kat nuŋe ta Yasel, Guni, Yeser, Silem.
Nane 7 ta Yakob tuku ndare. Yakob nu Bila ndoŋ Dan le Naftali kile-patikinaik. (Bila nu piro pino ande Labanŋge kulim nuŋe Rahel tuna tuku).
Yakob nuŋe ndare ŋakmba kilmba Isip kina ta ulendimba 66. Nuŋe rugan kat nuŋe ta turmba kilmba kina.
Yosef nu kiŋo armba Isipŋge kile-patikina. Ta tuku Yakob tuku kuasmbi ta ulendimba 70 kile Isipŋge minnaig.
Yakob nu nuŋe gageu ndoŋ Isipŋge minnaig
Yakob nu Yuda kukulna le nu amboŋga kumba ka Yosef sawa le pro Gosenŋge mam nuŋe kaŋgeram tuku ŋgina. Taŋakina le Yakob tuku kuasmbi ka Gosenŋge pronaig le
Yosef nu ismba karis poŋga kumba ka Gosenŋge mam nuŋe te-silikina sulumba nu mam nuŋe tugum promba pitik ndo mam nuŋe bagailmba malmbi didika mine kuenna.
Malmbi deŋpurna le Israel ndek Yosef sana: Ye ne abo minit ta kaŋgernet. Kile ye kumi ndeta maye ŋgina.
Kile Yosef ndek aba kat nuŋe mam nuŋe tuku kuasmbi ŋakmba wam paguka saniŋgina: Ye kile ka Farao teŋenmba sawamŋgit. Yiŋe aba kame mam tuku kuasmbi Kananŋge minnaig ta kile prowaig.
Nane sipsip makau kulatkade tuku. Nane naŋgine sipsip makau agaŋ ndende ŋakmba kilmba prowaig ŋga nu sawamŋgit.
Farao ndek tane wika kusnatiŋmba tane ame piro kade tuku ŋguwa ndeta

tane nu teŋenmba sawap: O gabat suŋgo, sine buk foŋfoŋ ndo agaŋmor kulatka pirokigeŋ ta kile mata sine taŋamba ndo piroka minmba mineg. O buk siŋgine wa mbuŋ kame pirokinaig taŋamba keg. Tane taŋamba sawap ta nu tane mapekuwa le Gosen ma mbolŋge minyokamŋgaig ŋga saniŋgina. Ta ndaŋam? Nane Isip mbal agaŋmor kulatkanu mbal ndoŋ ulendika minam mbulnaig. Ta tuku Yosef nu aba kat nuŋe taŋamba wam pagukina.
